newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 8.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 8.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Agnes Cser wiil remain in her post as head of the National Health Insurance Fund.
- Reconciliation talks are underway between the President and Vice-President of the opposition Christian Democrat party.
- Visitors arriving for the Formula One Hungaroring race cause unusually heavy traffic at border crossings.
- The 23rd Congress of the World Union of Reformed Churches started in the east Hungarian town of Debrecen.
